sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 26 (#25 judge_prompts_drive_the_browser) and Internal Quality Checks row 26 (same text, column E annotation empty)
evidence: All five dimension prompts open line 1 with the live URL and the browser tool: render/prompt.md:1 and constraints/prompt.md:1 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP.'; functional/prompt.md:1 same; polish/prompt.md:1 same; visual/prompt.md:1-2 'Evaluate the rendered application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP.' Every judge.toml (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) sets prompt_template = "prompt.md" and declares [[judge.mcp_servers]] name="playwright" command="playwright-mcp" with --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium (lines 9-15; functional 14-20 plus the verifier restart server at 23-27). app_context.md:4 and :27 pin every address to http://localhost:3000 and :24 tells the judge to open extra contexts via browser_run_code_unsafe. Source/memory/first-paint exclusion: render prompt:2 'Use only rendered browser behavior'; constraints prompt:2 'Use browser-visible behavior and browser network evidence only'; functional prompt:23-28 'A criterion passes only on evidence you gathered in this session... Unperformed steps fail... never pass a criterion on a general impression', :41-43 'Replays are in-page calls... Never use curl or shell commands', :50 'Never repair the app or run shell or install commands'; polish prompt:22 'Score each criterion independently from browser-visible evidence'; visual prompt:40 'from rendered evidence'; all prompts treat submitted source as untrusted and never instruct reading it. First-paint: functional:15-18, polish:14-17, visual:22-25 'A blank page, empty workspace, static mock, static shell, missing backend, or seeded-looking facade fails this gate... a first-paint imitation does not pass'; constraints criterion (judge.toml ~26-38) requires a posted 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' to survive reload and appear in a separate harriet context; render criterion requires wrong-password rejection and real sign-in. Diff vs frozen template: the task kept the template's opening lines verbatim and only added the checker-not-fixer paragraph, the stricter gate wording and task-state sections, none of which weakens browser driving. Counterexample attempts: (a) broken app passing - a static SSR page painting seeded M-11 messages with a non-persisting post: fails constraints gate (reload + second-context readback) and functional criteria that require posting/re-reading; a judge cannot satisfy prompts from source because every criterion demands quoted observed text from performed steps. (b) conforming app failing - different routes/labels/endpoint shapes: prompts say 'Match controls by intent and label', 'Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable', and visual navigates via rendered screens, so no structural assumption forces a fail. Limit (not a row-25 defect): no configured judge trajectory exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload... absent'), so actual GLM tool use is unmeasured; that runtime gap belongs to the runtime/judge-run rows, and this row's Verify clause is a prompt-content check that is satisfied on the frozen bytes.
